source.citation: NIST Computational Chemistry Comparison and Benchmark Database (CCCBDB), NIST Standard Reference Database 101, experimental vibrational fundamentals: carbon dioxide (CAS 124-38-9; values from Herzberg 1945) and water (CAS 7732-18-5; values from Shimanouchi and from Hu and Herzberg 1979)
